verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no opt-out from AI training. Greptile's own security page says it may aggregate and anonymize Customer Data and use it to train and improve AI models. Self-hosting, bring-your-own or self-hosted LLMs, and turning off logging are adjacent privacy controls, not a documented training opt-out, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
